Script.name: Bypass_Script
Script.script:
if type(Bypass) == "table" then if type(Bypass.shutdown) == "function" then pcall(Bypass.shutdown) elseif Bypass.summary_timer and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, Bypass.summary_timer) end end
Bypass = {} Bypass.version = "1.1.3"
local function bypass_note(msg) if type(cecho) == "function" then cecho("<gold>[Bypass] <white>" .. msg .. "\n") elseif type(echo) == "function" then echo("[Bypass] " .. msg .. "\n") end end
local function bypass_warn(msg) if type(cecho) == "function" then cecho("<tomato>[Bypass:warn] <white>" .. msg .. "\n") elseif type(echo) == "function" then echo("[Bypass:warn] " .. msg .. "\n") end end
local function format_bypass_shortname(area_code) local code = tostring(area_code or "") if code == "" then return code end if string.len(code) <= 4 then return string.upper(code) end return (code:gsub("(%a)([%w']*)", function(first, rest) return string.upper(first) .. string.lower(rest) end)) end
local function gmcp_get(path) local node = gmcp for part in string.gmatch(path, "[^%.]+") do if type(node) ~= "table" then return nil end node = node[part] end return node end
local function to_num(v) local n = tonumber(v) if not n then return 0 end return n end
local function persistence_dir() local home = (type(getMudletHomeDir) == "function" and getMudletHomeDir() or ".") local dir = home .. "/persistence" if type(mkdir) == "function" then pcall(mkdir, dir) end if type(lfs) == "table" and type(lfs.mkdir) == "function" then pcall(lfs.mkdir, dir) end return dir end
local CONFIG_FILE = persistence_dir() .. "/bypass_config.lua"
function Bypass.load_config() local ok, data = pcall(dofile, CONFIG_FILE) if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then if ok == false and data and not tostring(data):find("cannot open") then bypass_warn("Failed to read bypass config: " .. tostring(data) .. ". Falling back to defaults.") end Bypass.config = { version = 1, wishes = 0, instinct = false } return end
local valid = true if tonumber(data.version) ~= 1 then valid = false end local wishes = tonumber(data.wishes) if wishes ~= 0 and wishes ~= 1 and wishes ~= 2 then valid = false end if type(data.instinct) ~= "boolean" then valid = false end
if not valid then bypass_warn("Corrupt or invalid bypass config found. Falling back to defaults.") Bypass.config = { version = 1, wishes = 0, instinct = false } return end
Bypass.config = { version = 1, wishes = wishes, instinct = data.instinct, } end
function Bypass.save_config() local cfg = Bypass.config or { version = 1, wishes = 0, instinct = false } local f, err = io.open(CONFIG_FILE, "w") if not f then bypass_warn("Could not save bypass config: " .. tostring(err)) return end f:write(string.format("return { version = %d, wishes = %d, instinct = %s }\n", cfg.version or 1, cfg.wishes or 0, cfg.instinct and "true" or "false")) f:close() end
function Bypass.get_slot_allocation() local cfg = Bypass.config or { version = 1, wishes = 0, instinct = false } local subclass = tostring(gmcp_get("char.base.subclass") or "") local is_nav = (subclass == "Navigator") local int_val = to_num(gmcp_get("char.stats.int")) local wis_val = to_num(gmcp_get("char.stats.wis")) local stat_sum = int_val + wis_val
local wish_slots = math.max(0, math.min(2, tonumber(cfg.wishes) or 0))
local skill_slots = 0 if is_nav then skill_slots = 2 if stat_sum >= 800 then skill_slots = skill_slots + 1 end end
local instinct_slots = 0 if is_nav and cfg.instinct == true then instinct_slots = 1 end
local total_capacity = math.min(6, wish_slots + skill_slots + instinct_slots)
return { wish = wish_slots, skill = skill_slots, instinct = instinct_slots, total = total_capacity, is_nav = is_nav, stat_sum = stat_sum, subclass = subclass, } end
local CANONICAL_ALIASES = { ["gold rush"] = "goldrush", ["upper planes"] = "uplanes", ["lower planes"] = "lplanes", ["flying citadel"] = "citadel", ["deathtrap dungeon"] = "deathtrap", ["halls of the damned"] = "damned", }
local function canonicalize_area(name) local n = tostring(name or ""):lower():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") return CANONICAL_ALIASES[n] or n end
local RAW_BANDS = { { min = 2, max = 14, areas = { "graveyard", "gauntlet", "chessboard", "maelstrom" } }, { min = 15, max = 29, areas = { "gauntlet", "kul tiras", "chessboard", "maelstrom", "verume" } }, { min = 30, max = 39, areas = { "kingsholm", "dsr", "verume", "maelstrom" } }, { min = 40, max = 54, areas = { "kingsholm", "zangar", "citadel", "maelstrom", "dsr" } }, { min = 55, max = 59, areas = { "zangar", "gold rush", "citadel", "uplanes", "kingsholm" } }, { min = 60, max = 69, areas = { "upper planes", "flying citadel", "goldrush", "lplanes" } }, { min = 70, max = 85, areas = { "lower planes", "upper planes", "goldrush", "citadel" } }, { min = 86, max = 99, areas = { "lower planes", "upper planes", "deathtrap", "citadel" } }, { min = 100, max = 114, areas = { "xyl", "halls of the damned", "deathtrap", "talsa" } }, { min = 115, max = 119, areas = { "xyl", "deathtrap dungeon", "damned", "talsa" } }, { min = 120, max = 129, areas = { "talsa", "deathtrap dungeon", "ftii", "horath" } }, { min = 130, max = 139, areas = { "deathtrap dungeon", "zyian", "masquerade", "ftii" } }, { min = 140, max = 149, areas = { "cougarian", "cataclysm", "masquerade", "ftii" } }, { min = 150, max = 174, areas = { "cataclysm", "cougarian", "deadlights", "helegear" } }, { min = 175, max = 179, areas = { "deadlights", "cataclysm", "deadlights", "helegear" } }, { min = 180, max = 200, areas = { "partroxis", "nine hells", "deadlights", "helegear" } }, { min = 201, max = 201, areas = { "partroxis", "nine hells", "deadlights", "wyrm" } }, }
local EXPANDED_BANDS = {}
local function build_expanded_bands() EXPANDED_BANDS = {} for i, band in ipairs(RAW_BANDS) do local list = {} local seen = {} for _, a in ipairs(band.areas) do local ca = canonicalize_area(a) if not seen[ca] then table.insert(list, ca) seen[ca] = true end end
if i > 1 then local prev_list = EXPANDED_BANDS[i - 1].areas for _, a in ipairs(prev_list) do if #list >= 6 then break end if not seen[a] then table.insert(list, a) seen[a] = true end end end
table.insert(EXPANDED_BANDS, { min = band.min, max = band.max, areas = list }) end end
build_expanded_bands() Bypass.EXPANDED_BANDS = EXPANDED_BANDS
function Bypass.candidates_for_level(level) level = tonumber(level) or 0 for _, band in ipairs(EXPANDED_BANDS) do if level >= band.min and level <= band.max then return band.areas end end return nil end
function Bypass.build_assigned_slots(level, allocation) local candidates = Bypass.candidates_for_level(level) if not candidates or #candidates == 0 then return {} end
local total_capacity = allocation.total or 0 local slots = {}
local remaining_wish = allocation.wish or 0 local remaining_skill = allocation.skill or 0 local remaining_instinct = allocation.instinct or 0
for i = 1, math.min(#candidates, total_capacity) do local src = "wish" if remaining_wish > 0 then src = "wish" remaining_wish = remaining_wish - 1 elseif remaining_skill > 0 then src = "skill" remaining_skill = remaining_skill - 1 elseif remaining_instinct > 0 then src = "instinct" remaining_instinct = remaining_instinct - 1 end
table.insert(slots, { area = candidates[i], source = src, }) end
return slots end
local function run_bypass_commands(slots) Bypass.bypassed_areas = {} Bypass.bypassed_lookup = {} Bypass.confirmed_slots = {} Bypass.assigned_slots = slots if Bypass.summary_timer then killTimer(Bypass.summary_timer) Bypass.summary_timer = nil end
send("bypass clear", false) for _, s in ipairs(slots) do send("bypass " .. s.area, false) end end
local function report_bypass_summary() local confirmed = Bypass.confirmed_slots or {} if #confirmed == 0 then if type(cecho) == "function" then cecho("<ansiCyan>[INFO] <white>Bypass cleared (0 areas configured).\n") elseif type(echo) == "function" then echo("[INFO] Bypass cleared (0 areas configured).\n") end return end
local parts = {} for _, s in ipairs(confirmed) do table.insert(parts, string.format("%s (%s)", s.area, s.source or "confirmed")) end local summary = table.concat(parts, ", ")
if type(cecho) == "function" then cecho(string.format("<ansiCyan>[INFO] <white>You are now bypassing %d areas: %s\n", #confirmed, summary)) elseif type(echo) == "function" then echo(string.format("[INFO] You are now bypassing %d areas: %s\n", #confirmed, summary)) end end
local function assigned_source_for(area_code) local key = canonicalize_area(area_code) for _, slot in ipairs(Bypass.assigned_slots or {}) do if canonicalize_area(slot.area) == key then return slot.source end end return nil end
function Bypass_ApplyLevel(level) level = tonumber(level) or 0 if level <= 0 then return end
local alloc = Bypass.get_slot_allocation() local slots = Bypass.build_assigned_slots(level, alloc) run_bypass_commands(slots) end
function Bypass_ApplyCurrentLevel() local level = to_num(gmcp_get("char.base.level") or gmcp_get("char.status.level")) if level <= 0 then bypass_note("No GMCP level yet. Try again after score/level data arrives.") return end
Bypass_ApplyLevel(level) end
function Bypass_OnLevelUp(matches) local level = to_num(matches[2]) if level <= 0 then return end
Bypass_ApplyLevel(level) end
function Bypass_OnBypassLine(matches) local short_name = format_bypass_shortname(matches[3]) if short_name ~= "" then Bypass.bypassed_areas = Bypass.bypassed_areas or {} Bypass.bypassed_lookup = Bypass.bypassed_lookup or {} Bypass.confirmed_slots = Bypass.confirmed_slots or {} local lookup_key = canonicalize_area(matches[3]) if not Bypass.bypassed_lookup[lookup_key] then table.insert(Bypass.bypassed_areas, short_name) table.insert(Bypass.confirmed_slots, { area = short_name, source = assigned_source_for(matches[3]), }) Bypass.bypassed_lookup[lookup_key] = true end end
if Bypass.summary_timer then killTimer(Bypass.summary_timer) end Bypass.summary_timer = tempTimer(0.35, function() Bypass.summary_timer = nil report_bypass_summary() end)
deleteLine() end
function Bypass_Cmd_Config() local alloc = Bypass.get_slot_allocation() local cfg = Bypass.config or { version = 1, wishes = 0, instinct = false }
bypass_note("--------------------------------------------------") bypass_note(string.format("Bypass Configuration (v%s)", Bypass.version or "1.1.3")) bypass_note(string.format(" Wishes: %d slot(s) (configured: 0-2)", cfg.wishes or 0)) bypass_note(string.format(" Instinct: %s (%s)", cfg.instinct and "ON" or "OFF", alloc.is_nav and (cfg.instinct and "active: +1 slot" or "inactive") or "inactive: requires Navigator")) bypass_note(string.format(" Subclass: %s", alloc.subclass ~= "" and alloc.subclass or "None / non-Navigator")) bypass_note(string.format(" INT + WIS: %d (800+ bonus: %s)", alloc.stat_sum, alloc.stat_sum >= 800 and "YES" or "NO")) bypass_note(string.format(" Capacity: %d / 6 (Wish: %d, Skill: %d, Instinct: %d)", alloc.total, alloc.wish, alloc.skill, alloc.instinct)) bypass_note("Commands:") bypass_note(" bypass config wishes 0|1|2") bypass_note(" bypass config instinct on|off") bypass_note(" bypass apply") bypass_note("--------------------------------------------------") end
function Bypass_Cmd_ConfigWishes(matches) local val = tonumber(matches[2]) if val == 0 or val == 1 or val == 2 then Bypass.config.wishes = val Bypass.save_config() bypass_note(string.format("Wish slots set to %d.", val)) else bypass_note("Invalid wish value. Use: bypass config wishes 0|1|2") end end
function Bypass_Cmd_ConfigInstinct(matches) local val = tostring(matches[2] or ""):lower() if val == "on" then Bypass.config.instinct = true Bypass.save_config() bypass_note("Instinct slot turned ON (active for Navigator).") elseif val == "off" then Bypass.config.instinct = false Bypass.save_config() bypass_note("Instinct slot turned OFF.") else bypass_note("Invalid instinct value. Use: bypass config instinct on|off") end end
function Bypass.init() Bypass.load_config() bypass_note("Loaded (v" .. Bypass.version .. "). Use 'bypass config' or 'bypass apply'.") end
function Bypass.shutdown() if type(Bypass.save_config) == "function" then pcall(Bypass.save_config) end if Bypass.summary_timer and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, Bypass.summary_timer) Bypass.summary_timer = nil end end
Bypass.init()

Script.name: BypassMCheckBridge
Script.script:
local function bypass_mcheck_state_file() local home = type(getMudletHomeDir) == "function" and getMudletHomeDir() or "." local dir = home .. "/persistence" if type(mkdir) == "function" then pcall(mkdir, dir) end if type(lfs) == "table" and type(lfs.mkdir) == "function" then pcall(lfs.mkdir, dir) end return dir .. "/mcheck_bypass_mudlet_path.lua" end
local function bypass_mcheck_load_path() local ok, saved = pcall(dofile, bypass_mcheck_state_file()) return ok and type(saved) == "string" and saved or "" end
local function bypass_mcheck_save_path(path) local file = io.open(bypass_mcheck_state_file(), "w") if not file then return end file:write("return " .. string.format("%q", path)) file:close() end
Bypass.mcheck = { protocol = "1", addon_id = "bypass_mudlet", package_name = "Bypass_Mudlet", repository_id = "noobgonewild-mudlet-scripts", filename = "Bypass_Mudlet.xml", source_path = bypass_mcheck_load_path(), }
function BypassMCheckBridge(event_name, ...) local args = {...} local metadata = type(Bypass) == "table" and Bypass.mcheck or nil if not metadata then return end if event_name == "mcheck.scan.request" then local scan_id, protocol, requested_addon_id = args[1], tostring(args[2] or ""), tostring(args[3] or "") if protocol ~= metadata.protocol then return end if requested_addon_id ~= "" and requested_addon_id ~= metadata.addon_id then return end raiseEvent("mcheck.scan.response", tostring(scan_id or ""), metadata.protocol, metadata.addon_id, metadata.package_name, Bypass.version, metadata.repository_id, metadata.filename, metadata.source_path or "") elseif event_name == "sysInstallPackage" then local package_name, source_path = tostring(args[1] or ""), tostring(args[2] or "") if package_name == metadata.package_name and source_path ~= "" then metadata.source_path = source_path bypass_mcheck_save_path(source_path) end elseif event_name == "sysUninstallPackage" and tostring(args[1] or "") == metadata.package_name then if type(Bypass.shutdown) == "function" then pcall(Bypass.shutdown) end end end
